context_requirements: Functional cholesterol efflux machinery (ABCA1) for any direct target engagement
Hepatic or intestinal lineage for ABCB11/CES1-mediated effects
Macrophage or foam-cell context for anti-atherogenic transcriptional consequences
falsifiers: Reproducible induction of cholesterol synthesis genes (e.g., HMGCR, HMGCS1, INSIG1) at 6 h across multiple lines
Consistent upregulation of inflammatory or interferon programs at 24 h
Dose-dependent transcriptional changes in any of the nine lines at 10 micromolar
